title: treasure
summary: Something precious. Its name has a history hidden in plain sight.
question: Who gave English the word treasure?
completion: English treasure ← Middle English tresour ← Old French tresor ← Latin thesaurus. The spelling changed in England as well as travelling between languages. Italian tesoro is a related branch; the deeper history reaches Greek.
partner: A similar sound is a clue. Let’s check the evidence.
